## Profile

## Selected projects

- Xiao Yunzhi / 小云智: an AI study companion combining mistake memory with practical learning workflows. https://www.yunzhicompany.com/

## Website capabilities

The portfolio supports Chinese and English, light and dark themes, responsive desktop/mobile layouts, animated project and skill sections, an interactive click-heart effect, a persistent like counter, project showcases, certificate preview, and separate service pages for UI/experience design, frontend development, and brand/visual design.
